out.rationale: Both papers train agents within oversight protocols and report gains in judge or verifier accuracy, and the authors explicitly group their results with Arnesen et al.'s, so SUPPORTS. Settings differ: Arnesen et al. train debaters with DPO on QuALITY and judge with a fine-tuned GPT-4-Turbo, while the authors use expert iteration on code validation and also train the verifier.
